subject: Automated drawdown notifications and country tax attachments
messages:
From: Julian Hart <julian.h@pilgrimtech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@pilgrimtech.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prepay cadence + VAT documentation request

Hi Neha,

We're finalizing our FY28 cashflow and want to wire the committed prepay this week. A couple of asks so we can automate reconciliation on our side: 1) can Redwood send invoice PDF files as soon as each drawdown posts (automated SFTP or email)?; 2) can VAT/evidence spreadsheets be attached by country for each invoice so our AP team can validate reclaim eligibility?

We prefer an automated notification with the invoice attached and a small CSV summary with line items (model, tokens used, invoice amount, VAT). If you have an SFTP endpoint or a HubSpot invoice link we can poll, happy to consume that.

Also - who should our AP contact for SEPA remittance confirmations?

Thanks,
Julian Hart
Finance Lead, Pilgrim Tech
Attachments: none

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Hart <julian.h@pilgrimtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay cadence + VAT documentation request

Hi Julian — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a proposed automation plan below.

Summary answers:
- Invoice delivery: we can push PDF invoices to an SFTP endpoint and also email the PDF to your AP mailbox immediately after a drawdown posts.
- VAT evidence: we will attach country-specific supporting workbooks (spreadsheet) to each drawdown notification. Those files will include the invoice number, tax rate applied, and the jurisdiction code your AP team needs.
- SEPA / remittance confirmations: Karthik (cc'd) owns the bank remittance confirmations and will be the point for settlement receipts.

Proposed schedule / workflow (brief):
1) You provide SFTP details or confirm ap@pilgrimtech.com is acceptable for email delivery.
2) We configure automated drawdown alerts: immediate email + SFTP push when a drawdown consumes a prepay tranche. Each notification will include: invoice PDF, VAT_Evidence_xxx.xlsx, and a CSV summary.
3) We will include a unique invoice reference (RWI-8472-YYYYMMDD-#) so you can map to your ledger.

I've attached the invoice template we will use and an example VAT evidence workbook for the UK so your AP can validate the format.

Next steps: please confirm the SFTP host or give explicit OK to deliver to ap@pilgrimtech.com, and confirm which cadence you want for grouped vs. per-drawdown invoices (we support per-drawdown or daily consolidated).

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0142
Attachments: Redwood_PrePay_Invoice_2027-08.pdf (pdf), VAT_Evidence_GBR_Q2_2027.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Hart <julian.h@pilgrimtech.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay cadence + VAT documentation request

Julian — looping in bank ops and confirming settlement flow. A couple of operational notes: 

- For SEPA we'll send remittance confirmations to ap@pilgrimtech.com within 24h of settlement. If you require MT103 copy, confirm and we'll include that as a PDF on request.
- SFTP: we prefer a pull model with one inbound path (sftp.redwood.ai:/incoming/pilgrimtech/). If you prefer an email push, we'll throttle to avoid large bursts but will send each invoice right after drawdown.

Neha — for the automated alerts, can we default to per-drawdown PDFs for the first 30 days and then switch to daily consolidated if drawdown frequency is >5/day? This helps both teams validate mapping before consolidating.

Julian — if that's acceptable, confirm SFTP access or email OK and I'll kick off ops to provision the push.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Payments Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Julian Hart <julian.h@pilgrimtech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay cadence + VAT documentation request

Thanks — confirm SFTP now is preferred (we'll provision credentials this afternoon). Per-drawdown PDFs for the first 30 days sounds good. A couple of final asks:

- Could you include a short CSV column named "vat_claim_code" with the local code we need for UK/DE/NL so our ledger import maps properly?
- Please include the invoice reference on the SFTP filename as well (RWI-8472-20270824-01.pdf).

Once SFTP credentials are uploaded we'll share the host and path to you. Looking forward to the sample files — if everything matches we'll confirm the wire later this week.

Best,
Julian
Finance Lead, Pilgrim Tech
Attachments: none
